gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac swells its lowercase like blown glass bulbs. Oxanium draws smooth, tube-like lines with a commanding edge, while the body font keeps its turns wide and easy to follow.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Oxanium's strokes never vary, a single rounded line from start to finish. Noto Sans Syriac Western follows with terminals held well away from the stroke, so a long page feels modern and tidy.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Distinctive, flat, and contrast-free up top, with Oxanium leading. Noto Sans Tagalog keeps its curves generous and the middle of each line dense, so a long read feels clean and steady.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Oxanium's big lowercase and zero stroke modulation give it a look all its own. Noto Sans Tagbanwa sits next to it with open curves and clear gaps, which makes the two feel clean and modern together.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Approachable Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its strokes out before they touch, while Oxanium hums along as a soft, featureless line. And over a long passage the body font stays easygoing, with hardly any step from capital to lowercase.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Contemporary letters from Noto Sans Tai Tham crowd up toward the capital line. Oxanium does its best work with smooth curves and no pinched joins, while Noto Sans Tai Tham does its best with c shapes you can see straight into.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Oxanium builds every letter from a rounded rod of single weight, and it feels distinctive for it. But Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps ascenders short and terminals pulled back from the curves, so a long passage reads approachably.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Oxanium's curves run without any thinning, from the first stroke to the last, and it reads as commanding. Noto Sans Tamil makes the text look magnified.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Ruler-straight and sharp-looking, Oxanium takes the lead. And Noto Sans Tangsa, a plain sans with wide round openings, gives body text a little extra size to help those short ascender stems.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tc: Oxanium looks drawn with a technical pen, steady throughout. Its strongest quality is a firm, distinctive heading set against Noto Sans TC, a plain sans whose curves open outward.
